nodes.label: Continuing Obligations
nodes.summary: Ongoing obligations of listed issuers under the Listing Rules and SFO, including periodic reporting, disclosure of inside information, corporate governance, and transaction announcements.

nodes.label: Periodic Financial Reporting
nodes.summary: Listed issuers must publish annual reports (within 4 months of year-end), interim reports (within 3 months), and (for Main Board) quarterly financial updates.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.45 — Annual Report Timetable
nodes.summary: Annual report must be dispatched within 4 months after the financial year-end.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.46 — Interim Report
nodes.summary: Interim report must be dispatched within 3 months after the end of the first 6 months.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.48 — Preliminary Announcement
nodes.summary: Preliminary announcement of annual results must be published as soon as possible and no later than 3 months after year-end.

nodes.label: Disclosure of Inside Information
nodes.summary: Under Part XIVA of the SFO, a listed issuer must disclose inside information as soon as reasonably practicable. The disclosure must be accurate, complete, and not misleading.

nodes.label: SFO s.307A — Duty of Disclosure
nodes.summary: A listed issuer must disclose inside information to the public as soon as reasonably practicable.

nodes.label: SFO s.307B — Safe Harbours
nodes.summary: Safe harbours from the disclosure obligation, including where the information concerns incomplete proposals or trade secrets.

nodes.label: SFC Guidance on Disclosure of Inside Information
nodes.summary: Guidance on the statutory disclosure regime under Part XIVA, including practical examples of what constitutes inside information.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.09 — General Disclosure Obligation
nodes.summary: An issuer must announce any information necessary to avoid a false market or that would be reasonably expected to materially affect share price.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.10 — Trading Halt Guidance
nodes.summary: The Exchange may halt trading if information is not accurate or complete, or to maintain an orderly market.

nodes.label: Corporate Governance Requirements
nodes.summary: Issuers must comply with the Corporate Governance Code (Appendix 14 to the MBL Rules), covering board composition, directors' duties, internal controls, and shareholder communications.

nodes.label: MBL Appendix 14 — Corporate Governance Code
nodes.summary: Sets out principles and code provisions on board leadership, composition, remuneration, accountability, audit, and shareholder rights.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 3.08 — Directors' Duties
nodes.summary: Directors must act in the interests of the issuer and its shareholders as a whole, and comply with both common law duties and Listing Rule obligations.

nodes.label: Transaction Announcements
nodes.summary: Issuers must announce transactions that meet specified thresholds. The announcement must include details of the transaction, consideration, and the applicable percentage ratios.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.34 — Announcement Requirement
nodes.summary: An issuer must publish an announcement as soon as possible after the terms of a notifiable transaction are agreed.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 14.36 — Circular Requirement
nodes.summary: A circular containing prescribed information must be sent to shareholders for major and very substantial transactions.

nodes.label: Identify Trigger Event
nodes.summary: Step 1: Identify event requiring disclosure (financial results, inside information, transaction threshold).

nodes.label: Prepare and File Announcement
nodes.summary: Step 2: Prepare announcement, verify accuracy, file with HKEX.

nodes.label: Dispatch Circular (if required)
nodes.summary: Step 3: If transaction is major or very substantial, dispatch circular and convene shareholder meeting.
